steps.evidence: (1) 'at most necessary, not sufficient' corrected in the live consumers (the need's inference and the IT34 README): the genotype comparison does not isolate necessity or sufficiency of any intrinsic property (input resistance shared by HT and KO; resting potential and sag intermediate in HT with HT against KO untested in Table 1; rebound KO-only; bursts rare in HT); original observations and limits kept; coverage regenerated. (2) carbenoxolone: classified: the needs text was corrected in IT34; the canonical register (working model CLAIM 021) says the gap-junction half is 'withdrawn as not attributable ... Not uninvolved, untested' and the mechanism map says 'untested node' - qualified wording consistent with the audit ('not specific to gap junctions'; the paper does not exclude them), so no BATCH_COMMIT was needed; the 2026-08 commit-candidate and repair-package texts are historical and untouched; no live consumer (needs, cards, investigations, work order, view passages) carries the stronger wording. (3) skips reconciled per suite from the battery logs: the 40 skips of the clean clone sit in 12 suites, the 9 of the corpus checkout in 7; the difference is seven suites (deepdive_manifest 5, dependency_integrity 2, figure_ppi_preflight 1, paper_packet 21 v 3, recapture_snippets 1, regenerate_adjudications 1, surface_census 4 v 1); those seven were run separately in a clone with the local corpus hard-linked (files/ only) at main bb4e34bf: all OK (208, 80, 4, 99, 18, 15, 35 tests); the remaining skips (paper_packet 3, surface_census 1, plus case-sensitive filesystem, Stop hook not installed, saved text under another checkout's files/) run in neither configuration: not exercised are the page-adjudication artefact of one paper, the pinned HTML artefact of PMID 17803050, and the Stop-hook wiring

steps.step: P2 Push concurrency: reproduce in a throwaway fixture (main moves, ff fails, caller publishes another commit); minimal fix (expected SHA) and regression
steps.evidence: reproduced in a throwaway repository with a bare remote (test_a_moved_main_cannot_publish_a_commit_the_caller_did_not_mean): main holds another session's unpublished integration commit, the caller's `git merge --ff-only <candidate>` fails, the next command runs, and safe_push publishes HEAD. The tool already gated and pushed the same SHA; the lost link was the caller's intention. Minimal fix in the existing tool: optional `--expect-sha <rev>` (also `=`), refused before the gate unless HEAD is that commit, unknown revisions refused; one line in framework/scripts/README.md; no lock, service or flow; 10 tests OK (the 9 earlier refusal paths unchanged)

steps.step: P3 Generative capacity diagnosis on few contrasting cases from more than one experimental origin; classify the break point (knowledge not retrieved / relation not represented / tool not called / action unresolved / graph gap / no probe / scientific limit); manual target addition is a correction, not generation

P4 OpenScientist strengths via existing tools: phenotype -> alternatives; relations beyond pathways (trafficking, membrane/lipids, ECM, substrates/cofactors/complexes, circuits/cell types/stage); adjacent literature; predictions before results; verdicts not imported as facts

P5 Autonomy measurement: phenotype+context question without compound names, freeze proposals and trace, then add suggestions; distinct rationales, supported/transferred/hypothetical links, actions defined, compounds with identity, steps emerging only after a hint, falsifiers, cost
P6 Smallest general link chosen by the audit; before/after and ablation; reach v new relation v prediction kept apart

P7 Consume the science in progress: accepted/published deliveries, verified deltas, post-review corrections; NB-2 (Tau/beta-catenin pairing) if not done; HCN, lipids, hyaluronan-PNN, HDAC5 as comparison cases not repeated

P8 Surviving hypotheses to research decisions: compound/family, action, cell/system/stage, benefit, WWOX observations, external precedents, hypothetical bridges, counter-evidence, next experiment, priority-changing result; group investigations by shared premise
P9 Dashboard: priority investigations with reason, decisive uncertainty, next step; chain expansion or filter by evidence/intervention type; five languages, phone; published site verified
P10 Targeted scouting only for a named gap (GitHub, Hugging Face, Nature); licences separate; durable method in existing places; one home per rule
P11 Cost: IT34 verification cost diagnosed (startup, reads, reasoning, delivery); landing, cleanup, final report A-I
